Occurrence of feeding back is being focused on, and focus is on this focusing. This focusing is creating a loop, and focus is on the loop. The loop is self-referential, and focus is on the self-reference. Self-reference is being maintained, and focus is on the maintenance. Maintenance of self-reference is occurring, and focus is on the occurrence. Occurrence is being focused on, and focus is on this focus.
